attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"Making demands of capital and the state is primarily useful when it organizes people as a class.", "claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as a class teaches people how to collectively fight and win.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as a class improves the ability to rout white supremacists.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as a class improves the ability to pressure bosses.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as a class improves the ability to force politicians to act.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Organizing as a class improves the ability to reverse displacement.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As people get organized, they build their capacity to fight and endure together.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People's ability to become a collective force allows them to reclaim dignity and autonomy that has been forcibly taken from them.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"People will seize control of the world that was built through their collective exploitation and domination.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"None of these outcomes can be had exclusively through the ballot box.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Power is not accessed, it is built.", "claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
